facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. Hung Nhi Son Pagoda sits quiet while the beach crowds pile up nearby. No tour buses. No selfie queues. Just incense smoke, dragon carvings, and a pace Phu Quoc forgot to commercialize. If you need one hour off the resort circuit, this is it. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
